Australia is an important region for Sagemcom, with several Smart Water projects currently being deployed using NB‑IoT networks and our cloud‑based SICONIA platform. As part of the local team, you will work directly with customer technical teams, field engineers, and offshore R&D experts to ensure smooth operations and high‑quality system performance.
